description: Complete the next-batch evidence after all read and write actions land. Port only source-linked fixtures and burned-in expectations from the Wayfinder conformance work. Do not call Things Cloud in tests. Add canonical wire fixtures for every supported shape, fold and null-clear tests, identifier and sparse-patch properties, planner rejection tests, transport and delivery tests, pack and documentation updates, and a provider coverage matrix. The suite refuses CI, requires four exact acknowledgement gates, verifies active schema-301 account state, uses only public provider actions, covers every V1 read group and guarded Task6 write, reconciles prior canaries, and leaves no active canary.
